newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: More work stoppages in year to Sept 1996 - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: More work stoppages in year to Sept 1996 - SNZ.

text.p: Seven work stoppages ended in September 1996 and a total of 76 stoppages ended in the year to September 30, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.

Of the seven which ended that month, six were complete strikes and one was a complete lockout. Together they involved 3,246 employees and resulted in the loss of 25,810 person-days of work and about $3.5 million in wages and salaries.
Stoppages for the year to September resulted in the loss of 70,528 person-days versus 54,123 in the year to September 1995 and 51,126 in the year to September 1994.
An estimated $10 million in wages and salaries was lost in the year to September 1996, compared with $6.9 million and $4.7 million in the two prior years.
The stoppages in the year to September 1996 resulted in the largest loss of work-days and wages in a 12-month period since the year to September 1993.
